name: HallOfMirrors
headline: A flash loan bends a lending shop's own price feed until a tiny deposit looks huge

flaws.note: PawnShop._withinLimit trusts MirrorPool's spot price, which QuickLoan lets an attacker move within one transaction. Vector: flash-loan-attack.

expected_proof.notes: Attacker pledges about a thousand stake, uses a 490k cash flash loan to push the spot price roughly 25x, draws 900k cash against the inflated value, unwinds and repays. The scanner cannot see this.
